title: Add o8 next native terminal pane

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: O8 opens faster. The window paints in about 0.7 seconds instead of about 4.4 in a release build, because permission rules are compiled once instead of once per command. That also frees about 480 MB of memory.

Workers start faster. Dispatch to a ready worktree takes about 8 seconds instead of about 35: installed dependencies are reused across commits, a ready copy is moved into place instead of copied, and the launch checks ru
Typing while an agent works now steers it by default, and the composer says so. agent runtime leads take the steer in the middle of their current turn instead of after it.
Task dispatch over MCP returns its receipt right away, and progress follows in mission_tail, so agents no longer time out waiting for a worker to start.
After a compaction the lead keeps its transcript in order, and compaction uses the conversation's own context.
Agent runtime and other detached workers reconnect to their packets after o8 restarts.
Failed launches keep their cause. Backend readiness checks give up on time, queued dispatches say why they are waiting and when they retry, and lifecycle tools return the cause with a next step.
You can ask for a fresh update check.
